Notes: Release 1.1.51: Resolved race condition and application crash on call teardown (401 unauthenticated drops). Fixed 100% CPU spin loop on socket/IOException in TCP listener. Optimized parsing of TCP packets to remove O(N^2) allocations. Implemented synchronous DNS cache to resolve endpoint blockages. Added support for intercom auto-answer and message waiting indicator (MWI). Integrated live Call Quality Monitor (MOS scoring) and Call Waiting support. Optimized UI search debounce and implemented native Windows clipboard/device change notifications.
